title: Keepsake of our 1st Anniversary
reviewText: I wanted a bouquet that wouldn’t wither in three days. Sahil surprised me with the crochet lavender and tulip bouquet from Bloomora. It now sits proudly on our bedroom console and brings back all the wedding memories! Every petal is woven with so much love.

title: Cutest desk companion ever! 🌻
reviewText: The mini smiling sunflower is the absolute cutest thing on my entire work desk. The unboxing was so sweet with kraft paper wrapping and a handwritten note. Every colleague who passes my desk smiles at it!

title: Bespoke Bridesmaid Favors
reviewText: We ordered 12 custom daisy keychains with personalized color tags for my bridesmaids. The creator at Bloomora hand-packaged each one with satin ribbon and little handwritten cards. Unbelievable attention to detail and so lightweight on our bags!

title: Mom’s 60th Birthday Highlight
reviewText: My mom appreciates traditional handmade textiles and slow crafts. When she opened the custom pastel rose keepsake bouquet, she was in tears. She couldn't believe every single rose petal was hand-crocheted stitch by stitch. Truly an unforgettable gift.

title: Forever Fresh Desk Blossom
reviewText: The blooming pink crochet flower pot brightens up late-night study sessions. It never needs watering and stays vibrant every single morning. Best gift I got for myself!

title: Hometown warmth in Bengaluru
reviewText: Priya moved to Bengaluru for her new job, so I gifted her the strawberry amigurumi keychain to hang on her backpack. She loved that it came directly from our hometown in Vadodara! Dense, sturdy stitches that don't fray.
